Multiple dome-shaped, skin-colored papules present on the central face and around the eyes
buds and cords of basaloid cells enclosing small cystic spaces
response.rationale: R2 and R1 are synonymous terms for the same condition. R2 is the descriptive name directly matching the syndrome and has no contradicting spans, while R1 is the eponymous alias. The SUFU mutation and clinical/histopathologic findings are equally supportive of both, so the margin is low.
